import java.util.*;

public class TaskE {
    private static final long MOD = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        long L = sc.nextLong();
        long R = sc.nextLong();
        
        long rangeSize = R - L + 1;
        long odd = (L % 2 == 1) ? (rangeSize + 1) / 2 : rangeSize / 2;
        long even = rangeSize - odd;
        
        long total = n * m;
        
        if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) {
            System.out.println(power(odd + even, total));
        } else {
            long result = (power(odd + even, total) + power(even - odd, total)) % MOD;
            result = (result * modInverse(2)) % MOD;
            System.out.println(result);
        }
    }

    private static long power(long b, long e) {
        long res = 1;
        b %= MOD;
        for (; e > 0; e >>= 1) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) res = (res * b) % MOD;
            b = (b * b) % MOD;
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    private static long modInverse(long a) {
        return power(a, MOD - 2);
    }
}
